citation_note: The study supports an LGI2/ADAM23 receptor-complex/pathway branch controlling juxtaparanodal Kv1-complex clustering and stability. Lgi2 loss alone has little effect, while combined Lgi2/Lgi3 loss abolishes Kv1 clustering, showing partial redundancy rather than an LGI2-only relay.
